dex.entry: A cloud-fluff pup born inside a high cirrus cloud; its fur is made of compressed cloud-stuff that crackles with soft static, and it glows faintly gold at the edges when happy. A puppy made of cloud-fluff that sparkles — you'll want to hug it even knowing it shocks back.

art.silhouette: Plump round pup, fluffy white cloud-textured fur that puffs out at the paws and tail, faint gold edge-glow, two bright eyes and a tiny static-spark nose; irresistibly soft at 32px.
